header.modeUndecided: Mode undecided — declare Sun or Hokom.
header.orderSun: Order: A=11 > 10 > K=4 > Q=3 > J=2 > 9 > 8 > 7 (all suits alike, 120 a round)
header.orderHokom: Trump: J=20 > 9=14 > A=11 > 10 > K=4 > Q=3 > 8 > 7. Plain suits as in Sun (152 a round)

dealerStuck: You are the dealer. The dealer cannot pass.

hint.balootDeclareSun: You are strong in aces and kings — Sun favours you.
hint.balootDeclareHokom: One suit is long and strong — Hokom favours you.
hint.balootPassDeclare: Weak either way — passing is safer.
hint.balootFeedPartner: Your partner is winning — throw points on it.

tutorial.order: Baloot **changes the rank order itself with the mode**. Sun has no trump and the ace is highest; Hokom makes the chosen trump suit run J (20) > 9 (14) > A.
tutorial.declare: You see five cards, then declare Sun or Hokom (naming a trump suit). **You cannot pass when you are the dealer.**
tutorial.baloot: In Hokom only, holding both the trump king and queen scores 20 as Baloot. Sun has no trump, so it cannot happen.
tutorial.hand: Your hand. Legal cards get a green ring. When your partner (T0) is winning a trick, throw high-point cards on it.
